Selected work

Featured projects

Selected data analysis projects, combining careful data preparation with interactive reporting and visualization.

Project 01 · Excel + Power BI

Financial Transaction Analysis

This project explores a messy financial transactions dataset containing 525 rows and 6 columns. The data included missing values and inconsistencies that required cleaning and preparation before analysis. The resulting Power BI report presents financial activity through KPI cards and visual trends.

ExcelData cleaningPower BIDAXData visualization

Project 02 · Power Query + Power BI + DAX

Netflix Content Analysis | Power BI

An interactive analysis of Netflix’s content catalogue, built from a dataset of 8,790 records and 10 columns. The dataset covers Movies and TV Shows, countries, release years, content ratings, durations and genres. I used Power Query to clean and prepare the data, then Power BI and DAX to develop measures and visualizations exploring content distribution, global market presence, release trends, audience maturity ratings and genre patterns.

The five-page dashboard includes Overview, Global Content, Content Growth, Audience & Content, and Executive Business analysis. Interactive slicers, a landing-page Q&A button, page navigation and a Clear All Slicers button make it easier to explore the findings and reset filters.
